title: Objects, primitives, enums and literals: Use a Zod 4 strict object with bounded strings, enum values and explicit booleans to reject unexpected keys and impossible roles.
description: Zod 4 schema design with actual runtime parsing, negative test cases, a deliberately broken learner implementation, instructor solution and security boundaries.
objectives: Use a Zod 4 strict object with bounded strings, enum values and explicit booleans to reject unexpected keys and impossible roles.
Repair the failing zod-object-primitives schema and verify rejection behavior.
Explain the difference between runtime parsing and authorization.
rubric: I can explain Zod 4 runtime validation for objects, primitives, enums and literals.
I can fix the failing 09.01.01 starter with a real schema.
I can demonstrate valid and invalid input without claiming backend authorization.
